lyrics:

ആ... Rajani *yeh aaj tumara Pyasi suhani raat hamari Sajna sajna tum aao Sajna sajna tum aao Than mein ab aag hein Dil mein ek pyas hein (താരിടും...) Drowsy drowsy drowsy night Nice how nice this heavenly sky Come come and join me now Here Iam waiting oh my love (Drowsy...)
